name: CajaGrit
description: Sistema de Punto de Venta (POS) para gestión de cajas registradoras
author: Aronis Web

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.electron: cross-env NODE_ENV=development CI=false concurrently "npm run web:dev" "wait-on http://localhost:8081 && node node_modules/electron/cli.js electron.js"
scripts.electron:clear: cross-env NODE_ENV=development CI=false concurrently "npm run web:dev:clear" "wait-on http://localhost:8081 && node node_modules/electron/cli.js electron.js"
scripts.electron:export: expo export --platform web --output-dir web-build && node node_modules/electron/cli.js electron.js
scripts.electron:build: expo export --platform web --output-dir web-build && node fix-html.js && electron-builder build --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false --config.win.forceCodeSigning=false && node copy-assets.js
scripts.publish: expo export --platform web --output-dir web-build && node fix-html.js && electron-builder build --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish always && node copy-assets.js
scripts.publish:draft: expo export --platform web --output-dir web-build && node fix-html.js && electron-builder build --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish onTagOrDraft && node copy-assets.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:payment-flow && npm run test:pos-mappers && npm run test:app-updates && npm run test:crypto-offline && npm run test:offline-login
